Tartarus.text: Tartarus is Japan's maximum-security prison for villains too dangerous for any ordinary facility. It is built into a small volcanic island among the Izu Islands, about 55 kilometers south of the Tartarus Transfer Port at the tip of the Izu Peninsula, behind high sea walls inside a police exclusion zone. It is a national facility: a guard force under the National Police Agency runs custody and transfers, and the Hero Public Safety Commission vets every member of staff and approves every visit. Its rules are absolute. Nobody lands without written authorization, and only by armored transfer boat or helicopter from the port. Each inmate lives alone in a cell deep inside the island, built around that inmate's Quirk, with restraints that block it and automatic guns covering the bed. Inmates leave a cell only in full restraints with an escort of four guards, and no door in the prison opens without two officers confirming it. Visits are approved weeks ahead, limited in time, recorded and held across a thick transparent wall, with the prisoner strapped into a fixed chair under guns that fire at any sign of Quirk use; a guard reads the rules aloud first, and the visit ends at the first breach. Guards work long rotations on the island in armored gear. Only the worst offenders are sent there: serial killers, villains whose Quirks no ordinary cell can hold, and criminals judged too dangerous to live among other prisoners. To the public, Tartarus is the end of the line.
